senses.gloss: [Pipāsā, Māy 〔253.1〕, n. of a river, read (Skt.) Vipāśā.]
? pipāsin, adj. (= Pali ˚si; Skt. ˚sā plus -in), thirsty: read prob. bhukṣa-pipāsino (ed. ˚sitā, mss. cited as ˚sito; a n. pl. is needed) madhukarāḥ LV 〔328.12〕 (vs).

Pippalāyana, of a brahman (māṇava) living at Pippalavatī, who got a share of the fuel used in cremating the Buddha: MPS 〔51.19 ff.〕 He replaces the [] Pipphalivaniyā Moriyā (pl.) of Pali; acc. to DPPN a Pali Pipp(ḥ)alī-māṇava was a previous birth of Mahā-Kāśyapa.
